questions.prompt: What does the web-vitals JavaScript library do?

options.text: Runs a Lighthouse audit on the server
Measures the Core Web Vitals (LCP/INP/CLS, plus FCP/TTFB) in real user sessions and reports final values

questions.explanation: web-vitals is a field/RUM tool: it measures the vitals in real sessions and calls back with each final value so you can send it to analytics.

questions.prompt: To reliably send a metric to analytics as the page is unloading, use navigator.____().
questions.explanation: navigator.sendBeacon (or fetch with keepalive) reliably delivers the report even as the page unloads, when a normal request might be cancelled.

questions.prompt: Match each monitoring concept to what it is.

pairs.right: Performance measured from real users' sessions
The cause behind a slow metric (element, target, phase)
A pipeline gate that catches regressions before shipping

questions.explanation: RUM is your own field data, CrUX is the public benchmark, attribution explains why, and Lighthouse CI prevents regressions from shipping.

questions.prompt: Which are good production-monitoring practices? Select all that apply.

options.text: Judge with percentiles (p75) and segment by device/route
Know CrUX is Chrome-only, 28-day, and traffic-gated
Treat a launch-day Lighthouse score as sufficient monitoring
Use your own RUM to cover pages and browsers CrUX misses

questions.explanation: Reason in percentiles and segments, understand CrUX's limits, and use your own RUM for coverage. A one-off launch score misses the decay that follows.

questions.prompt: Why segment metrics instead of looking only at the overall p75?

options.text: Segmenting makes the numbers look better
A healthy overall p75 can hide a badly failing segment (e.g. low-end Android or one route)
Because p75 is not a real percentile
Segmenting is required to run Lighthouse

questions.explanation: Blended numbers mask trouble; slicing by device, connection, and route reveals the group that's actually suffering so you can fix the right thing.

items.text: RUM reveals a failing metric/segment in the field
A Lighthouse CI budget guards against the regression returning

questions.explanation: Field data finds the problem, attribution explains it, you fix it, CI prevents its return, and the field confirms the improvement.
